{{Quote|Guards! I need someone to haul this rotting thing from-- Guards?|Daiman, before being attacked by Kerra|<ref name="Knight Errant: Aflame 2">[[Knight Errant 2|''Knight Errant'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Duel on Chelloa''' was a duel between the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] at [[Daiman's compound]] on [[Chelloa]] during the [[Chelloan affair|Chelloa campaign]] of the [[Republic Dark Age]].

==History==
===Background===
{{Quote|No, my Lord... But I did build the comm set. It's just a hobby...''"<br />"''Nonsense. You have no need for leisure. Every act, every event in nature is a move for or against me. The information is in you--Why won't you let it out?''"<br />"''Yearrrrggghhh!|Skodo being interrogated by Daiman|<ref name="Knight Errant: Aflame 2" />}}
During [[Operation Influx]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] and a team of Jedi disrupted the shipment of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] ores within the [[Daimanate]] by raiding [[Oranessan]] and [[Chelloa]]. However, Operation: Influx came to an untimely end on Chelloa when the entire strike team with the exception of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] were wiped out during a confrontation with [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]], the leader of the [[Odionate]] principality and the estranged elder brother of Daiman. Holt was the sole Jedi survivor and was sheltered by [[Gorlan Palladane]], a former Jedi Knight and undercover Jedi agent who had supplied intelligence on Chelloa to Treece. Gorlan also led the [[Chelloan resistance]], an underground resistance dedicated to covertly assisting the Republic and Jedi in their war effort against the Sith.

Since the baradium operations on Chelloa were secret, Daiman sought to investigate how intelligence was leaked to his rival Odion. He apprehended the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Skodo]], a member of the Chelloan resistance, and had him tortured to death with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at his alpine compound above the mining colony of [[Jenith]].

===The duel===
{{Quote|Statue delivery was heading back for a refill. Just relax in your suspension field and tell me what I'm looking at. What's this here?|Kerra Holt and her "captive" Daiman|<ref name="Knight Errant: Aflame 2" />}}
Hijacking the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used to deliver one of Daiman's statues, Kerra Holt flew to Daiman's compound and landed in the hangar bay. Preoccupied with tormenting Skodo, Daiman did not sense Holt infiltrating the compound, quietly eliminating the guards outside the chamber. She sneaked a room and hid on top of one of Daiman's statues. After Daiman had finished with the deceased Skodo, he ordered his guards to remove the deceased Rodian from his chamber. However, he noticed that one of his statues had been beheaded. While Daiman was taken by surprised, Holt launched her attack, destroying the statue and pushing Daiman to the ground.

Amidst the scuffle, Holt trapped Daiman in a suspension field. She attended to Skodo but sensing no pulse, realized he was dead. She confronted Daiman verbally, attacking his destruction of Chelloa's environment and the use of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to operate his [[mobile munitions complex]]es. Daiman defended his actions by affirming his belief in the Sith tenet of self-glorification and reiterating his philosophy that reality was an illusion. While using his Force abilities to free himself from the suspension field, he distracted Holt by revealing that [[Odion]] was planning a second attack and had a mobile [[Space station/Legends|space station]]&mdash;[[The Spike (space station)|The Spike]]&mdash;capable of producing more of the deadly world-destroying [[kinetic corruptor]]s.

Breaking free, he managed to reactivate his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and turned to confront Holt. However, Holt had fled and hijacked one of Daiman's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], knocking out the pilot. Daiman had dispatched a flight of starfighters to attack Odion's space station. Rather than aborting the mission, Daiman viewed Holt as a tool against his main rival Odion.

==Behind the scenes==
The Duel on Chelloa first appeared in [[Knight Errant 2|''Knight Errant: Aflame'' 2]] as a plot device leading to the climax. It also sought to provide readers with more insight into the motives and nature of two major characters important to the plot: [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and her opponent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]
